description.en:
Distribution Manager
Allows fine-grained control over how production outputs are distributed to other production facilities.
Features: * New output mode: Manager — automatically distributes output to owned production points * Auto Equalize mode: Balances fill levels across destinations with configurable tolerance * Manual mode: Set custom percentages or caps per destination * Global-aware distribution: Multiple sources pushing to the same destination coordinate naturally * Overflow buffering: Excess output stays in source storage when destinations are full * Central overview screen accessible from the main menu * Full multiplayer support
Changelog: v0.1.0.0 - Initial release with core distribution engine
